commit.template: Look at the changes on this branch and commit them. Staged and unstaged changes are included. Just look at the changes to the files against master or the source branch. Don't look at the commit history. Be sure to include a commit message that describes the changes. Be concise and to the point. I don't need a Markdown document..
commit.description: Commit the changes to the repository.

pr.template: Look at the changes on this branch and create a pull request. Look at the changes to the files against master or the source branch. Don't look at the commit history. Be sure to include a pull request title that describes the changes. Be concise and to the point. I don't need a verbose description.
pr.description: Create a pull request for the changes.

build_status.template: Monitor the build status in CircleCi and Github for the open PR for this branch and look for any issue and attempt to fix them. Don't commit any changes, and ask me first before making changes.
build_status.description: Check build stats and attempt to fix any issues.

respond_to_comments.template: Look at the comments on the pull request and decided if you need to make a code change. If you do ask me first before making changes. If we make a change then respond to the comment and resolve the issue.
respond_to_comments.description: Respond to the comments on the pull request.
